{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for refunded orders with converted == 1
refunded_and_converted = df[(df['status'] == 'refunded') & (df['converted'] == 1)]
print(f"Number of refunded orders with converted=1: {len(refunded_and_converted)}")

# Filter to only completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(df_completed)}")

# Compute raw conversion rates by channel (unadjusted)
raw_conversion_rates = df_completed.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("Raw conversion rates by channel:")
print(raw_conversion_rates)

# Compute the raw difference (email - paid_search)
difference_raw = raw_conversion_rates['email'] - raw_conversion_rates['paid_search']
print(f"\nRaw difference (email - paid_search): {difference_raw}")"}
